brief: The canvas displays a background mimicking the textured, faded appearance of newsprint. From various points, dark, liquid-like shapes appear and constantly spread across the surface. These shapes represent wet ink, and their movement simulates the physical process of capillary action, causing the color to continuously bloom, diffuse, and expand into the surrounding paper fibers. The piece is entirely dynamic, showing the organic, uncontrollable passage of time solely through the spreading and interaction of these liquid ink patterns.

statement: This sketch simulates the organic spread of wet ink on newsprint, capturing the unpredictable and continuous motion of capillary action. Dark liquid shapes appear randomly across the canvas and gradually bloom outward, mimicking how ink diffuses into paper fibers over time. The subtle texture of newsprint provides a realistic backdrop, while the dynamic growth of each ink blob creates an ever-changing visual field that reflects the passage of time through its uncontrolled, natural processes.
